## Advisor angle
Clients holding gold or big tech positions are seeing both swing at once. An advisor might use the pending hike to revisit rate-sensitive holdings and to check that clients aren't over-concentrated in AI names. CNBC also ran a poll of top advisors on what they are doing with Nvidia after Huang's exit ([CNBC](https://news.google.?oc=5)).

## Term of the day: Rate hike
When the Fed raises its target interest rate, borrowing costs rise across the economy. The aim is to cool inflation, and the usual side effects are pressure on stocks and on assets like gold that pay no interest.

## Interview talking point
"With inflation beating forecasts three months running and a December Fed hike widely expected, I'm interested in how advisors balance rate risk against concentrated AI-stock exposure."
